## Summary

Describe the bounded problem, the proposed change, and explicit non-goals.

## Verification and evidence

- [ ] I ran the focused tests and recorded commands plus exit codes.
- [ ] I ran both PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 checks when scripts changed.
- [ ] I linked candidate-bound evidence and stated its evidence layer.
- [ ] I did not present a fixture, local demo, or candidate package as human acceptance, formal data, release, or independent adoption.

## Risk and rollback

Describe affected users, security or data concerns, and the reversible rollback method. Call out any human, public, external, or destructive gate that remains.

## Hygiene

- [ ] No API keys, tokens, cookies, passwords, personal data, private repository contents, or local absolute paths are included.
- [ ] Documentation, issue templates, and release notes match the tested behavior.
- [ ] This PR does not silently change the license, default branch, public release, or external accounts.
